(Trigger Effect) When the ally team lands a debuff on an enemy during their turn, uses <color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color>.
(If the debuff is stackable, applies only once on the first stack.)

<color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color> : Attacks all enemies and reduces all targets' <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turns</color>.
